1.w: For the one directing. According to Sheminith. A Psalm of David. Help, O YHWH! For the godly one ceases [to be]; for the faithful ones disappear from the sons of man.

2.w: Vanity they speak, each man with his neighbor; [with] lips of flattery with a double heart they speak.

3.w: May YHWH cut off all lips of flattery, a tongue speaking great [things]—

4.w: those who have said, “By our tongues we will prevail; our lips [are] with us; who [is] lord over us?”

5.w: “From the oppression of the poor, from the groaning of the needy, now I shall arise,” says YHWH. “I will set in safety [him who] breathes for it.”

6.w: The words of YHWH [are] pure words, silver refined in a furnace of earth, purified sevenfold.

7.w: You, O YHWH, shall keep them; You will guard them from this generation forever.

8.w: On every side the wicked walk, as vileness is exalted by the sons of man.
